verification_report.summary: The bounded audit verifies the text in order under the six explicitly accepted inputs. The constant-multiplier characterization, the equivalence between Gauduchon persistence and smooth mass invariance, the three-torus counterexample, and the nonexistence of a variational primitive on a non-Kahler Gauduchon surface are all correctly derived. In the bounded regime, decreasing exact regularization and bounded Bedford--Taylor continuity give a positive product of total mass M, while local capacity equivalence and the finite nonclosed-background expansion give approximation-independent weak continuity. All internal/classical cross-references match the stated accepted inputs and are applied with their required hypotheses. No critical error or gap was found; this verdict is limited to the supplied text and is not whole-book certification.
